== Description ==

[[Hayes Hunter]] (right, grey shirt over an olive T-shirt) stands with an unidentified player in a meeting room at the [[2022 World Championship]] in Atlanta. The poster's caption was that he had to show his wife how tall Hayes is.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #worlds-2022, CRG, 22 October 2022 (11:03 Eastern): "Because I had to show wife just how tall @hayes is." Original file name: IMG_4360.jpg (3024×4032); Slack file id F047PAAH63C.
* '''Shared by:''' CRG (Slack)
* '''Date:''' not recorded (posted 22 October 2022; taken in the event room during the weekend).
* '''Identification:''' [[Hayes Hunter]] (right, the taller of the two) is named as Hayes in the post and is the same person as in [[:File:2022 World Championship Hayes Hunter at a side table.jpg]] and #6 in [[:File:2022 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]. The player at left (glasses, beard, a green-and-yellow Superior cap, navy pullover, khaki shorts and flip-flops) is the photographer (Slack: CRG); his legal name is not yet dested.

Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
